turns.t: Doctor, Mr Hale, hives on and off for a fortnight. I've done his obs. Temperature 36.8, pulse 80, blood pressure 124 over 76.
Can we crack on? I've got a shift at six. ~
We'll be as quick as we can. Tell me about the hives.
Big red lumps, wherever. Arms, back, thighs. They itch like mad, last a few hours, then go, and come back somewhere else.
How long has it been going on?
Two weeks. Maybe a bit more.
Any swelling of your lips or tongue, or your face?
No. Never.
Any difficulty breathing, or wheeze?
No, nothing like that. I'd be in A and E if that happened.
Any fever, or have you felt unwell?
No fever. I feel fine, apart from the itching.
Have you changed anything recently, new soap, washing powder, food, medicines, a new job? ~
Nothing that I know of. I started doing nights at the bar last month, but that's it.
What's the bar? Anything you handle that's new? ~
Lemons, limes, loads of them. I'm cutting them all night. ~
That's worth noting. Does anyone in your family get skin things or hay fever?
My mum gets hay fever. Bad.
And do you drink at work, or after?
A couple of pints after the shift.
Doctor, shall I check his chest? ~
Please, Sam. And his arms. ~
Chest is clear, no wheeze.
Thanks. There are raised red wheals on his forearms and upper back, some joining up, and no swelling of the lips or tongue.
What are they, then? ~
What you describe, itchy raised weals that come and go, is typical of urticaria, hives.
Great. Can you stop them? ~
I'm going to start you on cetirizine, 10 mg once a day, taken at night. It blocks the itch.
Will it make me sleepy? ~
A bit, perhaps, but it's better at night, and see how you go before a shift. ~
Fine. ~
I'd also like to arrange a blood test, to look for anything underlying, like thyroid or infection.
Is that necessary? ~
With two weeks of hives, yes, it's sensible. ~
Okay, fine, I'll get it done tomorrow. ~
Try not to scratch, keep cool, and wear gloves when you cut the fruit.
Gloves. Cheers. ~
If your lips or tongue swell, or you get difficulty breathing, call 999 immediately.
I will. ~
